border-beam.name: border-beam
border-beam.title: Border beam
border-beam.desc: A comet of light that travels around the element border. Set mode="full" for a continuous gradient circuit.

delay.desc: Start offset. Use negative values to desync several beams.

length.desc: Beam length as a share of the full lap.

count.desc: Number of beams chasing each other.

mode.desc: beam = travelling comet, full = rotating gradient border.

glow.desc: Adds a soft two-tone halo around the element (uses box-shadow).

shimmer.name: shimmer
shimmer.title: Shimmer text
shimmer.desc: A band of light sweeps across text. Keeps the real text selectable and accessible.

color.desc: Base text color (defaults to the current color, dimmed).

shine.name: shine
shine.title: Shine sweep
shine.desc: A glossy highlight sweeps across a surface such as a button or card.

trigger.desc: loop = repeats forever, hover = sweeps once on hover.

aurora.name: aurora
aurora.title: Aurora background
aurora.desc: Slow, drifting aurora light behind the content of a section.

squircle.name: squircle
squircle.title: Squircle corners
squircle.desc: Smooth, continuous iOS-style corners. Native corner-shape where supported, an SVG clip-path fallback elsewhere.

fallback.desc: Where corner-shape is missing: clip = SVG clip-path, radius = plain rounded corners, auto = clip unless the element has a border or shadow.

glass.name: glass
glass.title: Liquid glass
glass.desc: Glass surface with rim light and specular sheen. Adds real edge refraction and chromatic aberration in Chromium; frosted glass everywhere else.

blur.desc: Backdrop blur (frost mode, and fallback browsers).

mode.desc: liquid = refraction where supported, frost = blur only.

shadow.name: shadow
shadow.title: Realistic shadow
shadow.desc: Five-layer soft shadow that looks physical. Optional hover lift, or a light source that follows the cursor.

light.desc: top = fixed light above, cursor = shadow moves away from the cursor.

reveal.name: reveal
reveal.title: Scroll reveal
reveal.desc: Animates the element in when it scrolls into view. Never leaves content hidden if JavaScript fails.

once.desc: Animate only the first time it enters the viewport.

stagger.name: stagger
stagger.title: Stagger children
stagger.desc: Reveals each child one after another when the group scrolls into view.

text-reveal.name: text-reveal
text-reveal.title: Text reveal
text-reveal.desc: Splits text into words, letters or lines and animates them in. Keeps links and inline markup intact.

style.desc: blur = focus in, rise = slides up from a mask, flip = letters unfold like pages, fade = opacity only.

stagger.desc: Delay between pieces (default 60ms words, 22ms letters, 120ms lines).

scramble.name: scramble
scramble.title: Text scramble
scramble.desc: Letters decode from random characters into the final text.

counter.name: counter
counter.title: Number counter
counter.desc: Counts up to the number in the text when it scrolls into view. Keeps prefixes, suffixes and the original number format.

marquee.name: marquee
marquee.title: Marquee
marquee.desc: Seamless infinite scroll of logos or cards with soft edges. Pauses on hover.

spotlight.name: spotlight
spotlight.title: Spotlight card
spotlight.desc: A soft light and a glowing border follow the cursor across the card.

magnetic.name: magnetic
magnetic.title: Magnetic
magnetic.desc: The element is pulled toward the cursor when it gets close, then springs back.

tilt.name: tilt
tilt.title: 3D tilt + glare
tilt.desc: Tilts toward the cursor in 3D with a moving light reflection. Children with data-fx-depth float above the surface.

cursor-image.name: cursor-image
cursor-image.title: Cursor image / label
cursor-image.desc: Hovering shows an image, icon or label that follows the cursor with a little momentum.

label.desc: Text or emoji to show instead of an image.

cursor.desc: none hides the native cursor while hovering.

parallax.name: parallax
parallax.title: Parallax
parallax.desc: Moves at a different speed than the page while scrolling. Runs on the compositor in modern browsers.

stack.name: stack
stack.title: Sticky stacking cards
stack.desc: Children stick and stack on top of each other while scrolling; covered cards shrink and dim.

top.desc: Distance from the top where cards stick.

offset.desc: Visible edge of each covered card.

shrink.desc: How much each covered card shrinks.

hscroll.name: hscroll
hscroll.title: Horizontal scroll section
hscroll.desc: Vertical scrolling moves a row of panels sideways while the section is pinned.

carousel.name: carousel
carousel.title: Drag carousel
carousel.desc: Native scroll-snap carousel with mouse drag and momentum, keyboard support and optional controls.

style.desc: scale = slides grow toward the center (coverflow).

autoplay.desc: Advance every N ms (0 = off). Pauses on hover and focus.

stories.name: stories
stories.title: Stories
stories.desc: Instagram-style stories: progress bars, tap left/right, hold to pause, swipe.

loop.desc: Start over after the last slide.

ripple.name: ripple
ripple.title: Liquid image (WebGL)
ripple.desc: Liquid ripples, lens magnification and RGB split follow the cursor over an image.

src.desc: Image URL when the host has no child.

morph.name: morph
morph.title: Shared-element morph
morph.desc: Names an element for View Transitions so it morphs between states or pages. Pair with lumafx.transition() or transitions.css.

page-transition.name: page-transition
page-transition.title: SVG page transitions
page-transition.desc: Animated SVG cover between pages of any site (WordPress and Webflow included). Covers on leave, reveals on arrival. Place one element anywhere in <body>.

duration.desc: Length of each half (cover or reveal).

label.desc: Text shown on the cover, e.g. your brand.

preloader.name: preloader
preloader.title: Preloader
preloader.desc: Full-screen intro with a 000→100 counter that follows real page loading, then lifts away. Hides itself after a few seconds even if JavaScript fails.

modal.name: modal
modal.title: Liquid modal
modal.desc: Accessible <dialog> that pulls out of the button, dock icon or link that opened it like a drop of liquid, detaches, and blooms into the panel; closing flows back into the trigger. Without a trigger it rises from the bottom edge. Open it with data-fx-open="#id", any link to href="#id", or modals.open().

style.desc: liquid = a gooey drop that pulls out of the trigger, glass = liquid-glass sheet with a jelly overshoot, scale = the page shrinks back behind it, slide = a clean spring.

from.desc: Where the liquid comes from: the button, icon or link that opened it (auto), or always the bottom edge.

side.desc: Dock the panel to an edge (a drawer or sheet) instead of the centre.

size.desc: Panel width (height for top and bottom).

root.desc: Page wrapper that shrinks back with style "scale" (default: [data-fx-sheet-root], #__next, #root, #app).

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.desc: A side panel or bottom sheet on a <dialog>: slides in with a spring, as stretchy liquid glass, with the page shrinking back behind it, pushing the page aside to make room, docked next to a page that stays usable, or as liquid out of the button that opened it. Click outside, Esc or data-fx-close closes it with the reverse animation.

style.desc: slide = spring, glass = liquid glass, scale = the page shrinks back, push = the page slides over to make room, dock = the page reflows next to the panel and stays usable, liquid = pours out of the button.

from.desc: For style liquid: where the liquid comes from.

root.desc: Page wrapper that shrinks back with style "scale".

hovercard.name: hovercard
hovercard.title: Hover card
hovercard.desc: A small card that springs open right next to the hovered or focused element and stays inside the viewport.

for.desc: Selector of the card content (hidden in the page).

text.desc: Plain text content instead of a selector.

chat.name: chat
chat.title: Chat widget
chat.desc: Animated chat launcher and panel: the button morphs into the window, messages slide in, a typing indicator bounces. Emits fx:chat-send so you can connect any backend.

greeting.desc: First message from you to the visitor.

quick.desc: Comma-separated quick replies shown as chips.

smart-header.name: smart-header
smart-header.title: Smart header
smart-header.desc: Hides while you scroll down, slides back as glass when you scroll up, and can dock an oversized hero logo into the bar as you scroll.

scrollbar.name: scrollbar
scrollbar.title: Animated scrollbar
scrollbar.desc: Custom page scrollbar with a springy thumb, section marks, and a label that pops up next to the cursor showing which section is at that point.

scroll-progress.name: scroll-progress
scroll-progress.title: Scroll progress
scroll-progress.desc: A reading-progress bar that fills as the page scrolls. Runs on the compositor in modern browsers.

dock.name: dock
dock.title: Magnifying dock
dock.desc: Icons grow as the cursor passes over them, like the macOS dock. Labels appear above the hovered icon.

magnify.desc: Maximum scale of the closest icon.

hover-icon.name: hover-icon
hover-icon.title: Hover icon
hover-icon.desc: Menu links slide an icon in on hover while the text makes room. Uses the data-fx-icon text, or a child marked data-fx-icon-el.

lightbox.name: lightbox
lightbox.title: Lightbox
lightbox.desc: Click a thumbnail and it grows into a full-screen viewer (View Transitions), with keyboard, swipe, zoom and a counter. Put it on a link to a large image, or on a gallery to page through every linked image inside.

group.desc: Links with the same group page through together.

image-reveal.name: image-reveal
image-reveal.title: Image reveal
image-reveal.desc: The image is uncovered by a moving mask while it settles from a slight zoom. Seven mask shapes.

from.desc: Direction or shape of the mask.

expand.name: expand
expand.title: Expand on scroll
expand.desc: An inset, rounded image or video grows to full width as it scrolls into the middle of the screen.

image-trail.name: image-trail
image-trail.title: Image trail
image-trail.desc: Moving the cursor leaves a trail of images that pop in and fade away.

images.desc: Comma-separated image URLs (or put children inside).

video-scrub.name: video-scrub
video-scrub.title: Scroll-scrubbed video
video-scrub.desc: The video plays forward as you scroll down and backward as you scroll up, pinned while its section passes.

length.desc: Scroll distance for the whole video.

smooth.desc: Smoothing (higher follows the scroll more tightly).

frames.name: frames
frames.title: Image sequence
frames.desc: Apple-style scroll animation from numbered images drawn on a canvas. Sharper and smoother to scrub than video.

src.desc: URL pattern, ### is replaced by the frame number: /seq/frame-###.jpg

length.desc: Scroll distance for the whole sequence.

svg-draw.name: svg-draw
svg-draw.title: SVG draw + flow
svg-draw.desc: Draws the strokes of an SVG when it scrolls into view (or with the scroll), and can send glowing pulses travelling along the paths.

mode.desc: view = draws once, scroll = drawing follows the scroll.

pulse.desc: Glowing pulses travelling along each path (0 = none).

dot-field.name: dot-field
dot-field.title: Dot field
dot-field.desc: A grid of dots that ripples away from the cursor and breathes when idle.

typewriter.name: typewriter
typewriter.title: Typewriter
typewriter.desc: Types the text letter by letter with a blinking caret. Child lines type one after another, like a terminal.

rotate-words.name: rotate-words
rotate-words.title: Rotating words
rotate-words.desc: Cycles through a list of words in place, with the width easing between them.

words.desc: Comma-separated words. The element text is the first.

rotate-words.example: We build brands

clock.name: clock
clock.title: Live clock
clock.desc: Shows the live time in any time zone, ticking every second.

tz.desc: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Tirane. Default: the visitor’s.

dapple.name: dapple
dapple.title: Leaf shadows
dapple.desc: Soft, slowly swaying shadows of leaves over a section, like sunlight through a tree.

ring.name: ring
ring.title: 3D ring carousel
ring.desc: Items stand on a 3D ring you can drag and fling; it turns slowly on its own when idle.

speed.desc: Idle rotation in degrees per second (0 = still).

card.name: card
card.title: Cards
card.desc: Five ready card designs for an image, a title, text and buttons: glow (border lights up around the cursor), product (lifts, image zooms), flip (3D flip to a back side), cover (full-bleed image, details slide up), ticket (event ticket with a perforated stub).

press.name: press
press.title: Button press
press.desc: Click feedback for buttons and links: a ripple from the click point, a burst of sparks, a fill that follows the cursor in and out, or a squish. Can swap the label to a done state ("Added ✓").

color.desc: Effect color (defaults to the current text color).

done.desc: Label shown for a moment after a click, e.g. "Added ✓".

form.name: form
form.title: Smart form
form.desc: Validation that feels alive, with the same rules on your server: messages slide in under the field, email typos get a "Did you mean…?" fix, phone numbers settle into international format, passwords get a strength meter, and AJAX submits show server errors on the right fields. Rules come from native attributes (required, type="email", minlength…) or data-rules="required email phone:AL".

locale.desc: Message language: en or sq (Albanian). Default: the page language.

country.desc: Default country for phone numbers typed without +.

ajax.desc: Submit with fetch and show the result in place (server errors appear on their fields).

spam.desc: Add a honeypot field and a time trap that schema().validate(…, { spam: true }) checks.

reset.desc: Clear the form after a successful AJAX submit.

success.desc: Selector of a message to reveal after a successful AJAX submit (or put data-fx-success on an element inside the form).

color.desc: Accent for focus, the strength meter and the sending spinner.

form.example: <form data-fx="form" data-fx-ajax action="/api/contact" method="post"><input name="email" type="email" required>…</form>

loader-3d.name: loader-3d
loader-3d.title: 3D loader
loader-3d.desc: Glossy 3D panels over a floating glass plate, rendered live on the GPU with soft shadows and studio reflections. pages: upright panels open like a book, spread into a ring and fold back. stack: flat tiles fan apart. For page preloaders, loading blog posts and any wait. Falls back to CSS 3D without WebGL; one shared GPU context serves every loader on the page.

colors.desc: Panel colors, comma-separated. The number of colors sets the number of panels (up to 6). Default: indigo to violet for pages, blue to violet for stack.

count.desc: Number of panels (1–6) when you give fewer colors; colors are blended to fill. Default 5 for pages, 4 for stack.

size.desc: Width and height of the loader.
